title: MowBite Planner on MowBite OS
description: The planner's part of MowBite OS' app interface, read by mowbite_api from the pinned planner (share/mowbite_planner_os/api). version counts up only when something is added. events: the planner's events on events/json, each the fields it has besides the envelope (id, t and type, set by mowbite_api), with its x-reasons; none yet. topics: the payload of each topic the planner publishes on bridge/publish. x-reasons: the reasons of the planner's events by event, none yet.

mowbite/planner/progress.description: Retained: how far the planning of an area got, at most every second while it runs and once more as it ends; also a change of what waits while nothing is planned. done of of (1000) grows with the planning's steps and with the time that area's last planning took.

area_id.description: The area planned (null: none planned yet, only what waits)

stage.description: The planning's stage (done as it ended well)

done.description: How far it got, of of

estimate_s.description: How long that area's last planning took

waiting.description: The first 20 of them in the order they'll run

area_id.description: The area it plans, if one

job.description: What it does: plan, mower, drive, leftovers, ...

ids.description: The RPC requests waiting for it

planned_on.description: Where it's planned (always mower on MowBite OS)

remote_why.description: Why not on the house computer after all (null on MowBite OS)
